name: composer-zoom
description: Resize Cursor's chat composer instantly with a keyboard shortcut, with independent zoom levels for the IDE and Agents windows.

composerZoom.defaultZoom.markdownDescription: Zoom level used before anything has been set, and the level the reset shortcut returns to.

composerZoom.step.markdownDescription: How much each keypress changes the zoom.

composerZoom.minZoom.markdownDescription: Lower bound, so the composer can never shrink out of sight.

composerZoom.maxZoom.markdownDescription: Upper bound, so the composer can never overflow the window.

composerZoom.separatePerWindow.markdownDescription: Remember a separate zoom level for the IDE window and the Agents window. Turn this off to share one level across both.

composerZoom.selector.markdownDescription: CSS selector for the element to zoom. Only change this if a Cursor update renames the composer element.

composerZoom.modifiers.markdownDescription: Modifier keys the shortcuts require. These are DOM names, so on macOS `meta` means Command (⌘) and `alt` means Option (⌥). Leave empty for the platform default: `meta`+`alt` (⌘⌥) on macOS, `ctrl`+`alt` (Ctrl+Alt) elsewhere. Shift is ignored unless you list it, so holding Shift to reach `+` still works.

composerZoom.growKey.markdownDescription: [KeyboardEvent.code](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/UI_Events/Keyboard_event_code_values) of the key that grows the composer.

composerZoom.shrinkKey.markdownDescription: [KeyboardEvent.code](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/UI_Events/Keyboard_event_code_values) of the key that shrinks the composer.

composerZoom.resetKey.markdownDescription: [KeyboardEvent.code](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/UI_Events/Keyboard_event_code_values) of the key that resets the composer to `#composerZoom.defaultZoom#`.
